name: Дістанься прапорця (2)
description:
What do you have to do?

In this game, you have to capture the flag. But you can’t simply walk to the flag. Not all squares are safe. Black’s pieces are protecting the flag. Make sure you don’t move to a defended square. Evade the enemy!


Hint: if you want, you can capture black pieces. By taking a black piece, unsafe squares can become safe. Sometimes, you can only reach the flag by taking a black piece that is blocking your path. In the example, the white knight needs to capture the bishop or it can never get to the flag.


Collect coins to score points. Your end goal is the flag.
